collection.title: Robert M. Gates Subject Files: Middle East Economic Strategy [1]-[2]
collection.methodology: Selected-file audit only. The first page of each PDF controls provenance. Every served-PDF page in the two companion folders was mapped to a document, working-note set, administrative page, inventory, or withdrawal sheet; candidates were deduplicated across the Gates pair and against the harvested Deal Chronological, Scowcroft Desert Shield, and H-Files collections.

fileUnits.reviewFocus: Read the full interagency economic action report, the Deal transmittal, the Pilling cost package, and the Egypt debt memoranda. Compare recipient-file copies against the Deal Chronological and Scowcroft Desert Shield files before selecting a controlling citation; preserve the exact extents of sheet-only records.
fileUnits.reviewKeyExtent: 125 served-PDF pages fully accounted for: 1 opening marker, 5 withdrawal sheets, and 119 served document, administrative, or working-note pages. Three sheets accompany released-in-part text; two sheets represent 8 logical pages with no document copy. The report sheet represents a further 4-page withheld appendix, for 12 logical pages not served in total.
